title: PNG text chunk carla:solar, format version 1
description: The sun the world reported on the tick nearest the pixels, and its illumination band, derived from that sun alone. A still whose world reported no sun carries no chunk. This schema describes format version 1; a chunk with no format_version was written before chunks carried one and is version 1.

format_version.description: The chunk's format version. Absent from a chunk written before chunks carried one, which is version 1.

solar_time.description: The sun's clock in its own time zone, hours from 0 up to 24.

time_zone.description: The time zone the sun's clock is read in, hours from UTC.

lat.description: The latitude the sun is computed for: the world's georeference origin, WGS84.

lon.description: The longitude the sun is computed for, WGS84.

sun_elevation_deg.description: The sun's geometric elevation above the horizon, with no atmosphere.

sun_azimuth_deg.description: The sun's azimuth, clockwise from true north.

advancing.description: Whether the engine itself moved the sun's clock with the world's tick. False in a SUMO drive, which writes an advancing sun itself on every tick.

rate.description: Sun-clock seconds per simulated second while the engine advances the sun.

sun_corrected_elevation_deg.description: The sun's elevation with atmospheric refraction applied: the elevation the frame was lit at. Absent where the server does not report it.

illumination_band.description: The illumination band of this sun. The bands are cut by the sun's refraction-corrected elevation in degrees: day above 6, golden above 0, civil_twilight above -6, nautical_twilight above -12, astronomical_twilight above -18, night at -18 and below. Absent where the elevation is not a sun's, such as the value the engine reports for a sun it could not compute.

illumination_band_elevation.description: Which elevation the band was cut from: the refraction-corrected one wherever the chunk carries it, the geometric one otherwise. Written with illumination_band and only with it.
